verdict.rationale: Render documents ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, and it can keep non-production environments from reaching production services. Together these give per-change isolated environments that let parallel work proceed. The evidence does not establish that these environments are unlimited, or explain how concurrency, limits or per-developer provisioning work across a team. Missing for 10: evidence of unlimited or concurrent environment counts, documentation of preview environment depth and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of team-wide parallel use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously

citations.quote: Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
Prevent non-production environments from accessing production services.
